assumptions: Attempt volume follows a Poisson process, mean 40 credential/vendor-access abuse attempts per year (illustrative, not derived from live data).
Impact minutes and analyst-hours follow log-normal distributions calibrated to plausible SOC investigation/remediation effort, not measured incident data.
Scenario effects (MFA, PAM, segmentation) are applied as independent multiplicative reductions on the relevant stage probability; combined-control scenarios are not modelled in this milestone.
Results are for relative, comparative decision support only, not an absolute forecast of real-world incident rates.
